card.name: Linking words before CYP2D6 drug examples
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (of, as, commas, e.g.,) just before a list of example drugs handled by the CYP2D6 enzyme, in interaction sections.

modes.label: Lead-in to examples
modes.description: The 'e.g.,' or 'for example,' that introduces CYP2D6 substrate drugs.

modes.label: Commas inside the drug list
modes.description: A comma after a listed CYP2D6 substrate such as desipramine or atomoxetine.

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward names of specific drugs and away from words like temporal or epilepsy terms.
card.plain: It fires on the little words and commas that lead into a list of example drugs affected by the CYP2D6 enzyme.
